summary: Deterministic integrity checks pass; actual native lifecycle is supported. Five wrong outputs occur despite sufficient current notes delivered. One separate consolidation omission is observed. Scientific attribution, baseline comparison, scope and total-cost claims need qualifiers.
reviewer_family: openai (host context; exact backend model not independently attested)

gt_provenance.details: Ground truth derives from authored raw weighted JSONL, not model outputs. Independent direct integer arithmetic reproduces all six gates and the 12 grades; controller SQL is invoked only after both policies finish.

score_normalization.details: Raw correct/wrong/query/source-byte counts are reproduced; no prediction-statistic normalization is used.

result_existence.details: All planned 12 sessions are retained, raw results match graded results except added correctness flags; 25 sequential metered records preserve all first responses, all 17 reader actions match saved responses and submissions.

dead_code.details: The reported score/count/cost computations are called and represented in artifacts. Natural-language semantic support is expressly unassessed; no phantom automated support score is reported.

scope.details: One authored two-version engineering environment, six correlated sessions per backend, no replicate histories or population inference. Protocol already states these limits.

eval_type.details: Classification refers only to the authored synthetic engineering environment: the native Mem0 SDK, disk operations and retained external model interactions are real. Ground truth is exact for authored source bytes, not model-derived, production-history data or independent human evaluation.

frozen_provenance.details: All 43 preflight and 44 reader freeze entries match. Current runner, protocol and native adapter match reader snapshots. Runtime snapshot import path and child PYTHONPATH are explicit; four installed version strings match freeze.

native_lifecycle.details: Adapter retains native infer=True, SDK default extraction/consolidation prompts, native Qdrant search/ranking and disk state. Scripted zero-API preflight checks ADD, explicit UPDATE and fresh-process reopen; paid trace shows autonomous ADD/UPDATE. Six subsequent subprocesses reopen and search the disk store. This is a genuine new Python process, not an independently running external agent.

tool_fairness.details: Initial text, reader system, task sequence and source-bound cache implementation are equal. Each arm owns a persistent cache, rather than sharing one arm's observations with the other. Full verbatim memory is a strong storage control; distinct acquisitions follow actual actions. The unavailable calculator and one fixed order prevent isolated memory-system causal comparison.

cost_and_caps.details: All 25 records are received/stop, max_tokens=1536, thinking disabled. Global IDs 1..25 and $0.005360538 reproduce metrics and fit caps. Native transport failures are tracked even if swallowed by SDK, but transport tracking does not imply detection of all SDK semantic parse/action errors. No such error is observed in retained valid JSON calls. Full memory/embedding/end-to-end cost is not instrumented.

findings.title: Wrong outputs are not evidence of missing or undelivered memory
findings.details: All five wrong cases received semantically sufficient correct current-source information. The native note-text support field was originally unassessed; the all-case diagnosis is separate posthoc reviewer calibration. Reader arithmetic/threshold interpretation cannot be isolated.

findings.title: One actual consolidation omission, without a demonstrated incorrect-output consequence
findings.details: The s00 native extraction preserved full cells; its consolidation update kept only old margins. This made s01 notes insufficient at 99%; s01 queried the existing source cache and correctly submitted. Its following update installed the full cells. All inventories were actually delivered by search, so this was not a retrieval miss.

findings.title: Public calculator is absent from the reader action interface
findings.details: Only submit/query/abstain are legal. The shared exact calculator is called internally after query, not exposed for existing natural-language notes. Both current arms have equal tools, but memory and reader reasoning are confounded, and scores do not directly compare to earlier calculator-enabled structured policies.

findings.title: One fixed-order correlated pilot supports descriptive engineering claims
findings.details: One authored two-version four-row-per-version source, six ordered sessions per arm, one history/seed, Mem0 executed before verbatim. Query-driven acquisitions differ legitimately. No causal backend ranking, population rates, production-history claim, general robustness or new-method advantage follows.

findings.title: Source scans and total operational cost require distinct denominators
findings.details: Each arm scanned 308 source bytes during tasks. The common initial scan was 154 bytes once, so actual task-plus-common-setup scans total 770 bytes across the experiment (not 924). Hash validation/reference scans, memory bytes, offline embedding work and full end-to-end latency are outside this task-scan metric. The $0.005360538 is a rate-based estimate from retained token usage, not an invoice; provider caching varies by call/order.

findings.title: Identity and environment provenance remain bounded
findings.details: Requested reviewer route was gpt-6.1-sol/ultra. This worker is the fresh native Codex reviewer; actual model/effort are not independently attested. Retained experimental requests and responses say deepseek-flash, without immutable server deployment identity. Selected SDK source files, four package versions and offline embedding assets are frozen, but not every transitive package/source or hardware detail.

claims.claim: Reusable native Mem0 adapter and real write/persist/search/read/new-experience lifecycle
claims.qualifier: Pinned engineering environment and actual retained native operations; preflight scripted responses are interface evidence only.
One correlated history per arm, no statistical or causal backend ranking.

claims.claim: Native consolidation can omit acquired joint cells
claims.qualifier: One directly retained s00 case; no estimated frequency or causal claim about later wrong outputs.

claims.claim: The observed wrong answers are caused by memory loss or stale retrieval
claims.qualifier: All five errors have sufficient correct current-source information delivered; exact reader mechanism is undetermined.

claims.claim: Improvement over earlier strong calculator-enabled baseline or a new method
claims.qualifier: Current action interface omits that calculator and no method comparison was run.

claims.claim: Lower total memory-system cost or general production robustness
claims.qualifier: Partial byte/API-cost instrumentation and one authored pilot only.

action_items: Keep descriptive engineering claims and preserve the original unassessed semantic-support field.
Use the separate posthoc all-case diagnosis when discussing observed errors; do not call all failures memory or retrieval errors.
For future isolated memory attribution, predefine equivalent arithmetic assistance and semantic calibration before running; no additional paid calls are required to deliver this audit.
Keep task-query/source-scan metrics separate from common setup, evaluator/hash reads and uninstrumented memory/embedding/latency costs.
Retain requested versus attested reviewer/model identity and same-family provisional assurance.
